title: Junctions as dirs doesn't work anymore
body:
### What happened?

I used to be able to sync the contents of NTFS junction directories. I recently noticed that it doesn't seem to work anymore.

I tried on 2 different machines, one with admin/systemwide install, the other with user install. On the systemwide install I added SyncthingServiceAcct to the perms on the sync'ed folder. The _Junctions as dirs_ option is set. 

Relevant logs below.

Here are some screenshots:
![syncthing_main](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9f85bbd5-fcfe-4494-a186-c336cecf9eda)
![files](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b4e08b5f-5321-4fba-95df-5c453097abb1)
![options](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/71523094-7113-4494-bc43-eae9b4ab9331)
![perms](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/94928024-32a6-4fb2-a863-ff559e66db9a)



### Syncthing version

v1.28.0

### Platform & operating system

Windows 10 Pro x64 

### Browser version

Brave Browser 1.71.114

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
I can confirm that something seems to have broken regarding the setting. In my test environment using just the basic Syncthing binary (so no permission issues that could be caused by the Windows installer, etc.), it doesn't seem to be able to detect the junction content at all.

I'm going to try investigating which specific version and possibly commit (or maybe a Go upgrade) is responsible for the regression.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: 8dc826b23 / #9651 is probably a good starting point

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: I can confirm that after compiling Syncthing v1.28.0 with Go v1.22, junctions work again, so the culprit is in Go v1.23.
